comments.author: Klinical
comments.body_html:
So weird with sptarkov these days. Before 15 people at once on a map was considered bad and “low pop”. I use to run around 30 people on a map moving at the same time with ALL the performance heavy mods. I ran the game at 60 fps aswell. Now I get 7 bots on the map with 45 fps. I miss 3.8.0

quick edit: I’m not looking for advice on how to fix it, just venting some frustration. The issue is prob due to my specs and I don’t care to fix it.

comments.author: RogueTech67
comments.body_html: I totally agree with you. I’ve been running every SPT version from day one on the same machine, and up to 3.8.x it ran pretty much the same way performance wise (mainly for 3.6.x thru 3.8.x). Starting with EFT 0.14.9 and SPT 3.9.0, every aspect of the game (load times, starting raid, in raid,…) is noticeably slower and at a lower FPS. I’ve looked on all the forums and sites for discussion on this, and have been shocked not have have really found any major talk. On my current rig, with both a clean 3.8.3 and clean 3.9.x, the 3.8.3 installation runs 10-20 percent better. Something noticeably changed performance wise in EFT 0.14.9.30626 and/or SPT 3.9.x compared to the previous EFT 0.14.1.2.29197 and SPT 3.8.x.
